slide.$description: Slide in: how far the placed item travels in from the inline start.

popScale.$description: Pop: peak scale as the placed item swells.

fadeScale.$description: Fade in: starting scale as the placed item appears.

gutter.$description: Margin reserved beside the list for the side marker, pointer and position rail, so they never sit under the dragged item or off screen.

markerSize.$description: Diameter of the numbered bubble on the side marker and position rail.

railDot.$description: Position rail: diameter of each position's dot.

markerOffset.$description: Margin indicators: distance from the slot's inline start to the centre of the gutter.

glowSpread.$description: Glow: blur radius of the target slot's halo.

arrowSize.$description: Arrows: size of the arrowheads at each end of the insertion line.
